description: Astraveyna is a team of college engineers, high school students and a middle schooler building tools that help astronauts stay healthy on long missions. We’re combining engineering, design and NASA research to make health monitoring simple enough to use every day, even millions of miles from home.
summary: We made a software that will take data from wearable devices and show wether the astonaut is safe to go out on high rhisk missions.
